brief.meaningEn: Preserve or continue a useful practice, idea or result into a later stage.
brief.meaningZh: 把有用的做法、想法或成果保留並延續至下一階段。
brief.grammar: Carry X forward / carry forward X; in passive, X is carried forward. It needs an object or a recoverable object in context.
brief.register: Neutral planning and policy language; a community organiser explains to volunteers which traditions should continue.
brief.boundaryZh: 延續有價值的做法，不等於把所有舊安排原封不動保留。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是把物件實際搬到前面，也不等於承諾永遠不改。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出要延續的具體做法及下一階段。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 249, row 10; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Useful customs deserve to be carried forward.

listening.en: The school will replace its timetable, but it will carry forward the quiet reading hour that pupils value.
listening.zh: 學校會更換時間表，但會把學生珍惜的安靜閱讀時段延續下去。
listening.promptZh: carry forward 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: Keep a valued practice in the new schedule.
options.zh: 在新時間表保留有價值的做法。

options.en: Move the books to the front of the room.
options.zh: 把書搬到房間前方。

options.en: Cancel the reading hour immediately.
options.zh: 立即取消閱讀時段。

options.en: Freeze every part of the old timetable.
options.zh: 保留舊時間表每一部分不變。

listening.explanationZh: 新時間表仍保留受重視的閱讀時段。

reply.promptEn: The neighbourhood festival is changing venues next year. Its free sign-language tour drew many visitors, and the team wants it at the new site. What should they say?
reply.promptZh: （社區節明年更換場地；免費手語導賞吸引了不少訪客，團隊希望新場地也有這項安排。該怎樣回應？）

options.en: We should retain the free tour at the new venue.
options.zh: 我們應在新場地保留免費導賞。

options.en: The tour can continue after the move.
options.zh: 搬遷後導賞仍可繼續。

options.en: Let us carry forward the free sign-language tour.
options.zh: 讓我們把免費手語導賞延續下去。

options.en: The change of venue need not end the tour.
options.zh: 更換場地不必終止導賞。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均支持新場地繼續提供已有成效的導賞。

scene.promptZh: 劇團改用新排練室，但去年行之有效的開場暖身環節仍會使用。哪句貼切？

options.en: The troupe will carry forward its opening warm-up in the new room.
options.zh: 劇團會在新排練室延續開場暖身環節。

options.en: The troupe will carry the chairs forward across the floor.
options.zh: 劇團會把椅子搬到地板前方。

options.en: The troupe must preserve every old rehearsal rule forever.
options.zh: 劇團必須永遠保留所有舊排練規則。

scene.explanationZh: 指定延續的是有效的暖身做法。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最清楚區分「延續有用做法」與「全部不改」？

options.en: The clinic carried forward its successful reminder system while changing appointment hours.
options.zh: 診所延續有效的提醒系統，同時更改預約時間。

options.en: The clinic carried forward every rule because any change is forbidden.
options.zh: 診所延續每一條規則，因為一切改動都被禁止。

options.en: The clinic removed the reminder system but said it had carried it forward.
options.zh: 診所移除了提醒系統，卻說自己把它延續下去。

contrast.explanationZh: 延續一項做法可以與其他改革並行。

dialogue.promptZh: 有人說 carry forward 必定是「把東西往前搬」。哪句修正較準確？

options.en: We can carry this useful idea forward into the next stage.
options.zh: 我們可以把這個有用想法延續至下一階段。

options.en: Yes; it can only describe a physical movement.
options.zh: 對；它只能描述實際移動。

options.en: No; it means throwing out every earlier idea.
options.zh: 不；它指拋棄所有較早的想法。

speaking.en: The library is redesigning its website, but it will carry forward the large-print option that readers depend on.
speaking.zh: 圖書館正重新設計網站，但會延續讀者倚賴的大字體選項。
speaking.promptZh: 說出新網站會保留哪項舊功能。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：劇院將推出新訂票平台；舊平台的無障礙座位篩選器很有用，團隊會在新版保留，其他版面可改。用英文說明。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應說明新平台、保留無障礙座位篩選器，以及其他版面仍可更改。

examples.en: The theatre will carry forward its accessible-seat filter into the new booking platform, even as it redesigns the other pages.
examples.zh: 劇院會把無障礙座位篩選器延續到新訂票平台，同時重新設計其他頁面。

examples.en: As the booking platform changes, the team will carry the useful accessible-seat filter forward while updating the rest of the layout.
examples.zh: 訂票平台改版時，團隊會延續有用的無障礙座位篩選器，並更新其餘版面。

takeaways.en: Carry forward preserves a specified practice into a new stage.
takeaways.zh: carry forward 指把指定做法延續至新階段。

takeaways.en: You can carry forward one useful feature while changing other details.
takeaways.zh: 可延續一項有用功能，同時更改其他細節。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Remain useful or appropriate in some circumstances, even if another option is often preferred.
brief.meaningZh: 即使另一選擇常受青睞，某做法在特定情況仍有用或合適。
brief.grammar: X has/have/had its/their place (in Y); singular X takes its, plural X takes their. The complement can name the relevant setting.
brief.register: Neutral comparative discussion; a transport planner speaks to residents weighing several travel options.
brief.boundaryZh: 承認某選擇在某些情況仍有價值，不等於聲稱它永遠最好。
brief.misconceptionZh: place 不是指定地理位置；不可忽略單複數代詞配搭。
brief.outcomeZh: 能讓步承認某方法的特定用途，同時保留比較。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 250, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: For short journeys, other forms of transport still have their place.
sources.expression: other forms of transport still have their place

listening.en: Digital forms are convenient, but paper forms still have their place when the network is down.
listening.zh: 電子表格很方便，但網絡故障時紙本表格仍有其用處。
listening.promptZh: have their place 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: Paper forms remain useful in this particular situation.
options.zh: 紙本表格在這種特定情況仍有用。

options.en: The forms are stored at a named location.
options.zh: 表格存放在指定位置。

options.en: Paper is always better than digital forms.
options.zh: 紙本永遠比電子表格好。

options.en: The network has already been repaired.
options.zh: 網絡已經修復。

listening.explanationZh: 電子表格方便，網絡故障時紙本仍有用途。

reply.promptEn: A school now posts most notices online, but some families lack regular internet access. A teacher asks whether printed notices should disappear entirely. How might you respond?
reply.promptZh: （學校現在大多在網上發布通知，但有些家庭無法定期上網。老師問應否完全取消紙本通知。你會怎樣回應？）

options.en: Printed notices remain useful for those families.
options.zh: 紙本通知對那些家庭仍然有用。

options.en: We should retain paper notices for families who need them.
options.zh: 我們應為有需要的家庭保留紙本通知。

options.en: Online posts are useful, yet printed notices still have their place.
options.zh: 網上發布有用，但紙本通知仍有其用處。

options.en: A complete ban on paper would leave some families uninformed.
options.zh: 完全不用紙本會令一些家庭收不到消息。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都承認紙本在特定家庭情況仍有用途。

scene.promptZh: 藥房新增網上諮詢，但有些長者仍需要當面說明。哪句貼切？

options.en: Face-to-face advice still has its place for these patients.
options.zh: 對這些病人而言，當面建議仍有其用處。

options.en: Face-to-face advice has its place at the back of the building.
options.zh: 當面建議的位置在建築物後方。

options.en: Online advice must be abandoned in every case.
options.zh: 所有情況都必須放棄網上建議。

scene.explanationZh: 不是否定網上服務，而是保留有需要時的當面建議。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句的單複數及讓步意思最自然？

options.en: Digital tickets are popular, but printed tickets still have their place.
options.zh: 電子票很普及，但紙本票仍有其用處。

options.en: Digital tickets are popular, but printed tickets still has its place.
options.zh: 電子票很普及，但紙本票仍有其用處。

options.en: Digital tickets are popular, so printed tickets must be used everywhere.
options.zh: 電子票很普及，因此所有地方都必須使用紙本票。

contrast.explanationZh: 複數 printed tickets 搭配 have their place，且只承認特定用途。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友把 have their place 解作「佔著一個座位」。哪句較準確？

options.en: Older methods still have their place when they meet a particular need.
options.zh: 舊方法在能滿足特定需要時仍有其用處。

options.en: Yes, it only refers to reserved seating.
options.zh: 對，它只指預留座位。

options.en: It means the older method must replace every new one.
options.zh: 它表示舊方法必須取代所有新方法。

dialogue.explanationZh: 片語在比較方法時指特定價值。

speaking.en: Short videos help, but detailed written guides still have their place when users need to check each step.
speaking.zh: 短片有幫助，但當使用者需要逐步查閱時，詳細文字指引仍有其用處。
speaking.promptZh: 說明文字指引在哪種需要下有用。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：畫廊推出語音導賞，但聽障訪客仍需要印刷文字說明。用英文承認兩種方式的作用，指出文字說明的特定用途。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應提及語音導賞、聽障訪客，以及印刷文字說明仍有用；不可說印刷方式在所有場合更好。

examples.en: Audio tours are helpful, but printed descriptions still have their place for visitors who cannot hear the recording.
examples.zh: 語音導賞有幫助，但對聽不到錄音的訪客而言，印刷文字說明仍有其用處。

examples.en: The gallery can offer an audio tour while keeping printed descriptions: they have their place for visitors with hearing loss.
examples.zh: 畫廊可以提供語音導賞，同時保留印刷文字說明；對有聽力障礙的訪客而言，文字說明仍有其用處。

takeaways.en: Have their place acknowledges value within a relevant context.
takeaways.zh: have their place 承認某選擇在相關情境有價值。

takeaways.en: Match has its place and have their place to the subject.
takeaways.zh: has its place／have their place 須與主語單複數配合。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Continue to exist or matter rather than disappearing on its own.
brief.meaningZh: 問題、需求或現象仍會存在，不會自行消失。
brief.grammar: X is/are not going away; negative progressive go away treats X as persistent. Often used of demand, problems or social changes.
brief.register: Neutral to conversational briefing; a housing officer explains continuing demand to a committee.
brief.boundaryZh: 表示目前可預見的持續性，並非斷言永遠不會改變。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是說人不肯離開某地；亦不表示問題已經解決。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出持續存在的需求並避免過度絕對化。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 252, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Demand for easier journeys is not going away.

listening.en: The library has extended weekend hours twice, yet the waiting list is not going away.
listening.zh: 圖書館已兩次延長週末開放時間，但輪候名單仍未消失。
listening.promptZh: not going away 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: The waiting list remains a problem.
options.zh: 輪候名單仍是問題。

options.en: Readers refuse to leave the building.
options.zh: 讀者拒絕離開大樓。

options.en: The library has no opening hours.
options.zh: 圖書館沒有開放時間。

options.en: The list has already vanished.
options.zh: 輪候名單已經消失。

listening.explanationZh: 延長時間後輪候名單仍然存在。

reply.promptEn: The council has opened one new evening class, but registrations still exceed the available seats each week. Is the demand over?
reply.promptZh: （議會增設了一班晚間課程，但每星期報名人數仍多於名額。需求是否已消退？）

options.en: No; registrations still exceed the seats.
options.zh: 沒有；報名人數仍超出名額。

options.en: The extra class has not removed the demand.
options.zh: 增班仍未消除需求。

options.en: Students still want evening classes, and that need is not going away any time soon.
options.zh: 學生仍想報讀晚間課程，這種需求短期內不會消失。

options.en: The council still needs to plan for more applicants.
options.zh: 議會仍需為更多報名者作規劃。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均根據每週超額報名指出需求仍在。

scene.promptZh: 某區連續三個月有許多人等候維修，新增一名技工後等候隊伍仍長。哪句貼切？

options.en: The repair backlog is not going away yet.
options.zh: 維修積壓目前仍未消失。

options.en: The technicians are not walking away from the workshop.
options.zh: 技工沒有走離工場。

options.en: The backlog has disappeared completely.
options.zh: 維修積壓已完全消失。

scene.explanationZh: 積壓持續，並非已經解決。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句避免把「目前持續」說成「永遠不變」？

options.en: The shortage is not going away this term, so we need a plan.
options.zh: 本學期短缺仍會持續，所以我們需要計劃。

options.en: The shortage is not going away, so it can never improve.
options.zh: 短缺仍會持續，因此永遠不可能改善。

options.en: The shortage ended yesterday, but we call it persistent anyway.
options.zh: 短缺昨天已結束，但我們仍稱它持續。

contrast.explanationZh: 片語可描述可見的一段時期，不預言永遠。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友以為 not going away 只指某人不肯離開房間。哪句較準確？

options.en: A continuing need is not going away simply because one extra class opens.
options.zh: 需求持續存在，不會因增開一班課便消失。

options.en: Yes; it only describes a person in a room.
options.zh: 對；它只描述房間裏的人。

options.en: It always means a demand has ended.
options.zh: 它一律表示需求已結束。

dialogue.explanationZh: 抽象需求也可持續而「不消失」。

speaking.en: Even after the extra buses arrive, passengers will still need late service; that need is not going away this winter.
speaking.zh: 即使增派巴士抵達，乘客仍需要深夜服務；這種需求在今個冬季不會消失。
speaking.promptZh: 指出持續的是哪種需求，以及時間範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區食物銀行增設一個派發時段，但每週排隊人數仍然超出可供應份數。用英文指出需求仍在，並說明需要繼續規劃；不要說它永遠不會減少。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應寫出新增派發時段、每週需求仍超出供應、須繼續規劃，並避免永久性的斷言。

examples.en: The extra distribution slot helps, but weekly demand is not going away: the food bank still needs to plan for more families than it can serve.
examples.zh: 新增派發時段有幫助，但每週需求仍未消失；食物銀行仍須為多於可服務數目的家庭作規劃。

examples.en: Although the food bank has added a distribution slot, more families arrive each week than it can serve, so the need is not going away and planning must continue.
examples.zh: 雖然食物銀行增設派發時段，每週到來的家庭仍多於可服務數目，因此需求仍未消失，規劃也須繼續。

takeaways.en: Not going away marks a need or issue that persists for now.
takeaways.zh: not going away 表示需要或問題目前仍在。

takeaways.en: A problem that is not going away now can still improve later.
takeaways.zh: 目前仍未消失的問題將來仍可能改善。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Put travellers in a place or situation with no workable way to continue or return.
brief.meaningZh: 令旅客缺乏可行的接駁或回程方法而受困。
brief.grammar: Leave + person/object + stranded; passive: passengers were left stranded. The travel context should establish lack of a usable connection.
brief.register: Neutral news and service-planning language; a station manager briefs passengers after a cancellation.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是沒有可行接駁或回程；單純晚到幾分鐘不一定構成受困。
brief.misconceptionZh: stranded 不只是「站著」，也不必指身處荒島。
brief.outcomeZh: 能根據是否仍有可行路線判斷受困。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 252, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: An expensive route can leave people stranded.

listening.en: The last ferry was cancelled after the bridge closed, leaving island residents stranded overnight.
listening.zh: 橋樑關閉後尾班渡輪取消，令島上居民整晚受困，無法離開。

options.en: They had no workable way off the island that night.
options.zh: 當晚他們沒有可行方法離開島嶼。

options.en: They chose to stand on the pier.
options.zh: 他們選擇站在碼頭。

options.en: The ferry arrived only five minutes late.
options.zh: 渡輪只遲到了五分鐘。

options.en: A replacement boat took everyone immediately.
options.zh: 替代船隻立即接走所有人。

listening.explanationZh: 橋封、尾班渡輪取消，當晚沒有可行離島途徑。

reply.promptEn: A shuttle to the hill clinic will stop at 5 p.m. The last scheduled clinic visits end at 6, and no other public route reaches the site. What is the risk?
reply.promptZh: （前往山上診所的接駁車會在下午五時停駛，最後一輪預約六時才結束，而且沒有其他公共路線可到達。風險是甚麼？）

options.en: Patients may have no way to travel back.
options.zh: 病人可能沒有方法返回。

options.en: The timetable leaves late patients without a return route.
options.zh: 時間表令晚離開的病人沒有回程路線。

options.en: Ending the shuttle early could leave patients stranded.
options.zh: 接駁車提早停駛可能令病人受困。

options.en: The clinic needs a later return connection.
options.zh: 診所需要較晚的回程接駁。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均根據接駁時差指出回程風險。

scene.promptZh: 演唱會後最後一班列車取消，主辦方沒有安排巴士，場地離市區很遠。哪句貼切？

options.en: The cancellation left concertgoers stranded.
options.zh: 列車取消令觀眾受困，無法離開。

options.en: The concertgoers merely stood beside the station.
options.zh: 觀眾只是站在車站旁。

options.en: A replacement train took them home immediately.
options.zh: 替代列車立即送他們回家。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最能保留 stranded 的判斷界線？

options.en: The bus was ten minutes late, but a working train was available; passengers were inconvenienced, not stranded.
options.zh: 巴士晚了十分鐘，但仍有列車可乘；乘客不便，卻未至於受困。

options.en: Any small delay automatically leaves everyone stranded.
options.zh: 任何短暫延誤都一定令所有人受困。

options.en: Passengers had no route home, but stranded cannot describe them.
options.zh: 乘客沒有回家路線，但受困一詞不能描述他們。

contrast.explanationZh: 有可行替代路線時，短暫延誤不等同受困。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說 stranded 必須在荒島才可用。哪句較準確？

options.en: A cancelled last bus can leave travellers stranded without a route home.
options.zh: 尾班巴士取消也可令旅客沒有回程路線而受困。

options.en: Yes; only people on deserted islands can be stranded.
options.zh: 對；只有荒島上的人才會受困。

options.en: It means travellers decide to stand still.
options.zh: 它表示旅客決定站著不動。

dialogue.explanationZh: 交通中斷也可令旅客受困。

speaking.en: If the night coach stops before the concert ends, it could leave rural visitors stranded without a return bus.
speaking.zh: 若夜間長途巴士在演唱會結束前停駛，郊區訪客可能因沒有回程巴士而受困。
speaking.promptZh: 指出造成受困的時間安排。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：海邊科學中心晚上九時閉館，唯一的公共巴士八時半已開走；中心尚未安排替代接駁。用英文指出晚離開的訪客會受困，並提出接駁需要。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都要寫出閉館與尾班巴士時間、沒有替代接駁、晚離開訪客的風險，以及需要安排回程。

examples.en: The science centre closes at nine, but the last public bus leaves at eight thirty. Without an alternative, this could leave late visitors stranded; the centre needs a return shuttle.
examples.zh: 科學中心九時閉館，但尾班公共巴士八時半已開走。沒有替代安排會令晚離開的訪客受困；中心需要回程接駁車。

examples.en: Late visitors would be left stranded if the centre closed at nine after the eight-thirty bus had gone. Since no replacement exists, a return connection is needed.
examples.zh: 中心九時閉館，而八時半巴士已開走，晚離開的訪客便會受困。既然沒有替代安排，就需要回程接駁。

takeaways.en: Leave someone stranded means no workable onward or return route.
takeaways.zh: leave someone stranded 指使人沒有可行的續程或回程路線。

takeaways.en: A delay alone may not leave someone stranded if a practical alternative remains.
takeaways.zh: 若仍有實際可行的替代方法，單純延誤未必令旅客受困。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Become part of a situation or begin to influence it.
brief.meaningZh: 某人或事物加入局面，開始影響情況。
brief.grammar: X enters/entered the picture; subject X is the new factor. Tense marks when it became relevant.
brief.register: Neutral narrative explanation; a project lead tells a team how a new partner changed its planning.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是新因素開始參與或影響局面，不是進入一張相片。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能把早已一直存在的因素說成剛剛 entered the picture，除非是它的作用剛開始。
brief.outcomeZh: 能按時間線指出新因素何時成為局面的一部分。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 253, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Ride-hailing services have entered the picture.

listening.en: The repairs were simple until a hidden pipe entered the picture and changed the cost estimate.
listening.zh: 維修本來簡單，直到一條隱藏水管成為新因素，改變了費用估算。
listening.promptZh: entered the picture 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: A newly discovered factor affected the plan.
options.zh: 新發現的因素影響了計劃。

options.en: Someone put a pipe into a photograph.
options.zh: 有人把水管放進照片裏。

options.en: The estimate stayed unchanged.
options.zh: 估算完全沒有改變。

options.en: The pipe had been the stated focus from the beginning.
options.zh: 水管從一開始就是已說明的焦點。

listening.explanationZh: 隱藏水管出現後，費用估算隨之改變。

reply.promptEn: A small bookshop planned a poetry night on its own. Then a nearby café offered its upstairs room, giving the organisers twice the seating. What changed?
reply.promptZh: （小書店原本獨自籌辦詩歌晚會。後來附近咖啡店提供樓上房間，座位數因此增加一倍。發生了甚麼變化？）

options.en: The café became a new partner in the plan.
options.zh: 咖啡店成為計劃的新合作夥伴。

options.en: The offer changed how many guests they could host.
options.zh: 這個提議改變了可接待的賓客數目。

options.en: Once the café entered the picture, the event could seat more people.
options.zh: 咖啡店加入後，活動可容納更多人。

options.en: The organisers gained an additional venue.
options.zh: 主辦者多了一個場地。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均指出咖啡店後來加入並帶來新場地。

scene.promptZh: 小組原本只比較兩款海報設計，後來贊助人提出必須加入多語言版本，討論方向因此改變。哪句貼切？

options.en: A language requirement entered the picture and changed the design discussion.
options.zh: 多語言要求成為新因素，改變了設計討論。

options.en: The requirement was already the only topic from the start.
options.zh: 這項要求從開始就是唯一議題。

options.en: A poster literally entered a printed picture.
options.zh: 一張海報真的進入印製的圖片裏。

scene.explanationZh: 新的要求後來才影響討論。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最清楚表現新因素的時間順序？

options.en: The budget was settled first; a safety rule entered the picture later and forced a revision.
options.zh: 預算先定妥；其後新安全規定加入局面，令計劃須修改。

options.en: The safety rule was the sole factor from day one, so it entered the picture for the first time today.
options.zh: 安全規定從第一天就是唯一因素，卻說今天才首次加入局面。

options.en: A painter added a rule to a drawing, so the rule entered the picture literally.
options.zh: 畫家在畫中加入規定，因此規定真的進入圖畫。

contrast.explanationZh: 先後次序支持新因素後來影響計劃。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說 entered the picture 只可用於攝影。哪句修正較準確？

options.en: A new sponsor entered the picture after the first budget meeting.
options.zh: 第一次預算會議後，新贊助者加入局面。

options.en: Yes, it only names a photograph.
options.zh: 對，它只指照片。

options.en: It means a factor has disappeared from the situation.
options.zh: 它表示某因素已從局面消失。

dialogue.explanationZh: 贊助者後來加入計劃，是抽象用法。

speaking.en: The project was nearly ready when a new safety requirement entered the picture, so the team revised the launch date.
speaking.zh: 項目原本快準備好了，但新安全要求加入局面，團隊因此修改推出日期。
speaking.promptZh: 指出新因素，以及它改變了甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區菜園原本按舊水費預算。之後業主提出新的節水規定，義工須修改種植時間。用英文指出規定後來加入並帶來改動。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應寫出原本按舊水費預算、新節水規定後來出現、義工修改種植時間。

examples.en: The garden had budgeted under the old water charge, but a new saving rule entered the picture and volunteers had to revise the planting schedule.
examples.zh: 菜園原本按舊水費編預算，但新的節水規定加入局面，義工須修改種植時間。

examples.en: Volunteers planned around the old water charge. When the landlord’s new saving rule entered the picture, they changed the planting timetable.
examples.zh: 義工原本按舊水費規劃；當業主的新節水規定加入局面，他們便更改種植時間表。

takeaways.en: Enter the picture marks a new factor joining a situation.
takeaways.zh: enter the picture 表示新因素加入局面。

takeaways.en: When a constraint entered the picture, earlier plans may need revision.
takeaways.zh: 限制因素加入後，早前計劃可能須修改。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Assemble separate pieces of information or travel legs into a workable whole.
brief.meaningZh: 把分散的資料或路段拼合成可行的整體。
brief.grammar: Piece X together / piece together X; object X can be a journey, account or plan. In the source, travellers combine several apps into one trip.
brief.register: Neutral explanatory language; a traveller describes to a friend how she assembled a route from separate sources.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有分散部分及拼合的過程；只有一條現成路線不需「拼湊」。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是把紙本拼圖黏起來，也不表示資料一定完整無缺。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出各部分如何合成一條可行路線或一個理解。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 253, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Commuters piece their journeys together using several apps.

listening.en: With no single timetable, Lena pieced the route together from a train notice and a ferry board.
listening.zh: 沒有統一時間表，Lena 從列車通告及渡輪告示拼湊出路線。
listening.promptZh: pieced the route together 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: She combined separate details into a route.
options.zh: 她把分散資料合成路線。

options.en: She broke a map into paper pieces.
options.zh: 她把地圖撕成碎紙。

options.en: One complete schedule gave her everything.
options.zh: 一份完整時間表已提供所有資料。

options.en: She abandoned travel planning.
options.zh: 她放棄規劃行程。

listening.explanationZh: 列車和渡輪資訊分散，需要合併。

reply.promptEn: A nurse is travelling between two rural clinics. One app shows the morning bus, another lists the ferry, and a posted notice gives the last shuttle. No source shows the complete trip. What is she doing?
reply.promptZh: （護士要往返兩所鄉村診所。一個程式列早班巴士，另一個列渡輪，張貼通告則列出尾班接駁車；沒有單一來源顯示全程。她正在做甚麼？）

options.en: She is combining several travel legs.
options.zh: 她正把數段交通路線合起來。

options.en: She is building one itinerary from scattered notices.
options.zh: 她正從分散通告組合行程。

options.en: She is piecing her journey together from three sources.
options.zh: 她正從三個來源拼湊行程。

options.en: She needs the three sources to see the full trip.
options.zh: 她需要三個來源才能看清全程。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均描述把分散資料組成全程。

scene.promptZh: 考古隊從三本舊日記的日期與地點重建一次遠征，沒有單一完整紀錄。哪句貼切？

options.en: They pieced the expedition together from separate diaries.
options.zh: 他們從分散日記拼湊出那次遠征。

options.en: They followed one complete record without comparing sources.
options.zh: 他們只按一份完整紀錄，沒有比較來源。

options.en: They glued the diaries into a physical puzzle.
options.zh: 他們把日記黏成實體拼圖。

scene.explanationZh: 分散線索可拼合成較完整的經過。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最能顯示「拼合分散部分」？

options.en: The team pieced the schedule together from separate venue emails.
options.zh: 團隊從不同場地的電郵拼湊時間表。

options.en: The complete schedule was handed to the team, so they pieced together nothing.
options.zh: 完整時間表已交給團隊，因此毋須拼合。

options.en: The team cut the schedule into pieces for decoration.
options.zh: 團隊把時間表剪碎作裝飾。

contrast.explanationZh: 不同電郵提供各部分，需合成整體。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說 piece together 只表示資料毫無遺漏。哪句修正較準確？

options.en: We can piece a provisional account together from partial reports, then check gaps.
options.zh: 我們可從部分報告暫時拼湊經過，再核對缺漏。

options.en: Yes, it guarantees every detail is known.
options.zh: 對，它保證所有細節已知。

options.en: It means we must ignore every partial report.
options.zh: 它表示必須忽略所有部分報告。

speaking.en: I pieced my weekend route together from the rail update, the local bus board and a hotel notice.
speaking.zh: 我從鐵路更新、當地巴士告示及酒店通告拼湊出週末路線。
speaking.promptZh: 指出三項分散資料來源。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校想安排參觀天文台，但列車時刻、步行封路通知和場地開放時間分散在三個來源。職員把它們合成一份可行行程，仍會核對缺口。用英文說明。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應提及三類分散資訊、合成可行行程，並表明仍會核對缺口。

examples.en: Staff pieced the observatory trip together from the train times, road-closure notice and opening hours, then checked the remaining gaps.
examples.zh: 職員從列車時刻、封路通知及開放時間拼湊天文台行程，然後核對餘下缺口。

examples.en: The school pieced together a workable observatory visit using train times, walking-route changes and the site’s opening hours, while checking for missing connections.
examples.zh: 學校利用列車時刻、步行路線改動及場地開放時間，拼湊出可行的天文台參觀行程，並核對有否遺漏接駁。

takeaways.en: Piece X together combines separate parts into a workable whole.
takeaways.zh: piece X together 把分散部分拼合成可行整體。

takeaways.en: You can piece together an account without claiming every gap is closed.
takeaways.zh: 可以拼湊出經過，而毋須聲稱所有缺口都已填補。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Well connected and coordinated across parts of a service or plan, especially in British English.
brief.meaningZh: 服務或計劃各部分互相連接、協調連貫；常見於英式英語。
brief.grammar: Joined-up is an attributive or predicative adjective: a joined-up service / the service is joined-up; more joined-up compares degrees of coordination.
brief.register: Neutral British English policy language; a clinic coordinator explains integrated appointment systems to staff.
brief.boundaryZh: 不只是把實體東西接在一起；重點是使用者跨環節的服務連貫。
brief.misconceptionZh: 拼寫通常保留連字號；各部門各自運作而互不傳遞資訊時，不算 joined-up。
brief.outcomeZh: 能根據跨環節協調證據判斷服務是否連貫。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 254, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The rail network is more joined-up after the extension.

listening.en: The clinic now shares appointment notes with its pharmacy, so patients no longer repeat their details; care is more joined-up.
listening.zh: 診所現在與藥房共用預約備註，病人毋須重複資料；服務更協調連貫。
listening.promptZh: more joined-up 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: The two services coordinate better for patients.
options.zh: 兩項服務為病人更好地協調。

options.en: Staff physically join two buildings.
options.zh: 職員把兩幢樓實際接起來。

options.en: Patients must enter their details twice.
options.zh: 病人必須兩次輸入資料。

options.en: The pharmacy stops receiving information.
options.zh: 藥房不再收到資料。

listening.explanationZh: 共享資料減少重複，是跨服務協調。

reply.promptEn: A student books a library study room online. The desk staff immediately see the booking and the access code arrives in the same account. How would you describe the new process?
reply.promptZh: （學生網上預約圖書館自修室，櫃檯職員即時看到預約，門禁碼亦送到同一帳戶。如何描述新流程？）

options.en: The booking and access steps now connect.
options.zh: 預約及進入步驟現在互相連接。

options.en: Staff and students share the same booking information.
options.zh: 職員與學生看到相同預約資訊。

options.en: The process is more joined-up for users.
options.zh: 對使用者而言，流程更協調連貫。

options.en: The student no longer has to repeat the booking at the desk.
options.zh: 學生不必再於櫃檯重複預約。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均根據預約、櫃檯、門禁環節的銜接作答。

scene.promptZh: 社區中心的活動報名、付款與場地確認已連到同一系統，無須每步重新輸入姓名。哪句貼切？

options.en: The registration process is more joined-up.
options.zh: 報名流程更協調連貫。

options.en: The centre has joined its desks with glue.
options.zh: 中心用膠水黏合櫃檯。

options.en: Each step still has no record of the previous one.
options.zh: 每個步驟仍看不到上一步資料。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最有證據支持 joined-up？

options.en: Bus and rail apps now share disruption alerts, making the trip planner more joined-up.
options.zh: 巴士與鐵路程式現在共用受阻通知，令行程規劃更連貫。

options.en: Each transport app hides the other service’s timetable, so the system is joined-up.
options.zh: 各交通程式都隱藏其他服務時間表，因此系統很連貫。

options.en: A bridge links two stations physically; no information or service is coordinated.
options.zh: 橋樑把兩站實際連起，但資訊或服務沒有協調。

contrast.explanationZh: 跨交通服務共享通知是協調證據。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友以為 joined-up 只描述接駁兩根水管。哪句修正較準確？

options.en: A joined-up plan connects the work of different teams.
options.zh: 協調連貫的計劃能銜接不同團隊的工作。

options.en: Yes, it only describes plumbing.
options.zh: 對，它只描述水管。

options.en: It means every team works in isolation.
options.zh: 它表示每個團隊各自孤立工作。

dialogue.explanationZh: 抽象服務與計劃也可協調連貫。

speaking.en: The housing team and repair desk now share case updates, giving residents a more joined-up service.
speaking.zh: 房屋團隊與維修櫃檯現在共用個案更新，為居民提供更協調連貫的服務。
speaking.promptZh: 指出哪兩個部門的資訊開始銜接。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：大學的學生輔導預約、轉介和跟進原先分散；新系統讓三個環節共用進度，學生毋須重複講述問題。用英文評估新服務。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應寫出預約、轉介、跟進三環節共用進度，以及學生毋須重複說明。

examples.en: The university now has a more joined-up support service: booking, referral and follow-up share progress, so students do not have to repeat their story.
examples.zh: 大學的支援服務現在更協調連貫：預約、轉介和跟進共用進度，學生毋須重複講述自己的情況。

examples.en: By linking bookings, referrals and follow-ups in one record, the university offers joined-up support without making students explain the same issue again.
examples.zh: 大學把預約、轉介與跟進連到同一紀錄，提供協調連貫的支援，學生毋須再次解釋相同問題。

takeaways.en: Joined-up describes coordination across connected parts.
takeaways.zh: joined-up 描述多個環節互相協調。

takeaways.en: A more joined-up service reduces needless repetition for users.
takeaways.zh: 更協調連貫的服務可減少使用者不必要的重複。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Remove small hassles or points of resistance from a process.
brief.meaningZh: 減少流程中的小麻煩或阻力，讓事情更順暢。
brief.grammar: Take the friction out of + noun/gerund; subject is a change or tool, object names the affected process. May say take some of the friction out of.
brief.register: Neutral product or service explanation; a school administrator describes a smoother form process to parents.
brief.boundaryZh: 表示減少繁瑣環節，不必聲稱所有問題或成本完全消失。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是物理摩擦；一項功能若只改外觀而不改善流程，不宜如此形容。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出具體減少了哪一步麻煩。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 254, row 6; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Digital tickets take the friction out of daily travel.
sources.expression: take the friction out of daily travel

listening.en: One shared login takes the friction out of renewing a library card because readers no longer fill in the same form twice.
listening.zh: 單一共用登入減少續領圖書證的繁瑣，因為讀者不必重複填寫同一表格。
listening.promptZh: takes the friction out of 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: It removes a repeated step from the process.
options.zh: 它減少流程中重複的一步。

options.en: It polishes the card to make it slippery.
options.zh: 它把圖書證擦滑。

options.en: It removes every possible cost of borrowing.
options.zh: 它消除借書的一切可能成本。

options.en: It merely changes the website colour.
options.zh: 它只更改網站顏色。

listening.explanationZh: 共用登入免卻重填表格，是流程改善。

reply.promptEn: Parents used to enter the same child details on three school trip forms. A new form fills those details once for all three sections. What does it do?
reply.promptZh: （家長以前須在三份學校旅行表格重複輸入子女資料；新表格一次填寫便帶入三個部分。它有甚麼作用？）

options.en: It saves parents from repeating the same entry.
options.zh: 它免卻家長重複輸入相同資料。

options.en: It removes a small but real hassle.
options.zh: 它減少一項雖小但實在的麻煩。

options.en: It takes the friction out of trip registration.
options.zh: 它減少旅行報名的繁瑣阻力。

options.en: It makes the registration steps smoother.
options.zh: 它令報名步驟更順暢。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均描述免重複填寫帶來的流程改善。

scene.promptZh: 診所新系統自動帶入已核實的地址，病人毋須每次手寫同一資料。哪句貼切？

options.en: It takes the friction out of repeat appointments.
options.zh: 它減少覆診流程的繁瑣。

options.en: It physically removes friction from the clinic floor.
options.zh: 它實際消除診所地面的摩擦。

options.en: It only changes the font and leaves all steps unchanged.
options.zh: 它只改字體，所有步驟不變。

scene.explanationZh: 自動帶入資料減少重複步驟。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句沒有誇稱「一切問題已解決」？

options.en: The shortcut takes some of the friction out of booking, though payment still needs work.
options.zh: 捷徑減少部分預約麻煩，付款環節仍待改善。

options.en: The shortcut takes the friction out of booking, so no user can ever have a problem.
options.zh: 捷徑減少預約麻煩，因此使用者永遠不會有問題。

options.en: The shortcut changes a colour only, yet it removes a repeated form.
options.zh: 捷徑只改顏色，卻說免卻重複表格。

contrast.explanationZh: 片語可指部分阻力減少，不代表完美。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友以為 friction 在這裏必須涉及輪胎或地板。哪句較準確？

options.en: A single payment screen can take the friction out of renewing a pass.
options.zh: 單一付款頁面可減少續證的繁瑣。

options.en: Yes, only moving objects have friction.
options.zh: 對，只有移動物件才有摩擦。

options.en: It means a service deliberately adds more steps.
options.zh: 它表示服務刻意增加步驟。

dialogue.explanationZh: friction 可比喻流程中惱人的阻礙。

speaking.en: The new receipt scanner takes the friction out of expense claims by reading the date and amount automatically.
speaking.zh: 新收據掃描器自動讀取日期和金額，減少報銷申請的繁瑣。
speaking.promptZh: 指出被省去的手動輸入工作。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區泳池的網上續證原本要求會員每次重新輸入姓名與會員號碼；更新後資料會安全帶入，但付款仍需手動完成。用英文說明改善及界線。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應寫出姓名與會員號碼不用重填、續證更順暢，但付款仍須手動完成。

examples.en: Secure autofill takes some of the friction out of pool-pass renewal by saving members from retyping their names and numbers, although payment still needs a manual step.
examples.zh: 安全自動填入功能免卻會員重輸姓名和會員號碼，減少泳池續證的繁瑣，但付款仍須手動完成。

examples.en: The renewal page now brings in a member’s name and number safely, taking the friction out of repeated data entry; members still complete payment themselves.
examples.zh: 續證頁面現在安全帶入會員姓名及號碼，減少重複輸入資料的繁瑣；會員仍須自行完成付款。

takeaways.en: Take the friction out of names a process made easier.
takeaways.zh: take the friction out of 指流程變得更順暢。

takeaways.en: Taking some of the friction out of a task does not remove every step.
takeaways.zh: 減少部分繁瑣不等於消除每個步驟。
